name: io.github.sepehr071/ime-mcp
title: Iran Mercantile Exchange
description: Read-only Iran Mercantile Exchange (ime.co.ir): physical trades, supply, prices, market totals.

environmentVariables.name: IME_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the ime.co.ir requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
